title: dryopteris × boottii f. multiflora
intro: Dryopteris × boottii f. multiflora, commonly known as the Autumn Fern or Multiflowered Wood Fern, is a hybrid fern species that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the Autumn Fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant have been traditionally used to treat various conditions, including fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.
